annotation.title_clean: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.title_en: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Cabinet Affairs, United Arab Emirates
annotation.summary_en: UAE government policy document setting out the country's international stance on AI, built on six guiding principles (advancement, collaboration, community, ethics, sustainability, safety). It stresses international cooperation, participation in global standard-setting, transparency and accountability, and positioning the UAE as an AI hub. It has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Six guiding principles: advancement, collaboration, community, ethics, sustainability, safety
Active participation in international forums shaping AI standards and guidelines
Supports international alliances and rules holding nations accountable for harmful AI development
Adopts the eight-principle AI Principles and Ethics framework as a living document
Builds on the UAE Charter for the Use and Development of AI; funding for research centers and startups
